exposure: maternal stressful life events with perceived distress during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 56 mothers who had 105 pregnancies, comprising 56 children diagnosed with neuroblastoma (cases) and 49 unaffected control siblings.
finding: Maternal stressful life events during pregnancy and certain congenital pathologies were independently associated with an increased risk of neuroblastoma in children.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between mode of delivery and neuroblastoma risk.
